description: Coboundary delta f of an odd linear map f: g -> g; see docs/math/C_coboundary_definition.md.

f_map.parameterization: f(Z_src) = sum_tgt phi__src__tgt * Z_tgt  (tgt opposite parity; K allowed for odd sources); f(K)=0

delta_f.coeff: phi__E_eps1_del3_mm__H_1 - phi__E_eps1_del3_mm__H_3 - phi__E_eps1_del3_mm__H_4 + phi__H_1__E_eps1_del3_pp - phi__H_2__E_eps1_del3_pp - phi__H_3__E_eps1_del3_pp + 2*phi__H_4__E_eps1_del3_pp
phi__E_eps1_del3_mp__H_1 + phi__E_eps1_del3_mp__H_3 + phi__E_eps1_del3_mp__H_4 - phi__H_1__E_eps1_del3_pm + phi__H_2__E_eps1_del3_pm + phi__H_3__E_eps1_del3_pm
